reason: A Chrome extension that bridges allowlisted plaintext browser cookies to a local computer-use receiver so browser sessions can start authenticated; review is warranted because it handles sensitive authentication data and requests broad host permissions.

summaries.zh: 一款 Chrome 扩展，可按允许列表读取明文 Cookie 并将其发送到本机接收器，以便计算机使用工具导入浏览器会话。
summaries.en: A Chrome extension that reads allowlisted plaintext cookies and sends them to a localhost receiver for import into a computer-use browser session.

capabilities: Reads plaintext browser cookies through the Chrome cookies API
Sends selected cookie values to a localhost HTTP receiver
Polls a local request queue for cookie extraction requests
